SavedQueries.Name: Order summary
SavedQueries.Sql: SELECT * FROM vw_OrderSummary ORDER BY OrderedAtUtc DESC LIMIT 100;

PublishedEndpoints.Name: Vegetarian pizzas by calories
PublishedEndpoints.Sql: SELECT PizzaId, PizzaName, Size, Price, EstimatedCalories, AverageRating, Toppings FROM vw_CurrentMenu WHERE IsVegetarian = 1 AND EstimatedCalories <= @max_calories ORDER BY EstimatedCalories, PizzaName;

PublishedEndpoints.Name: Search menu and reviews
PublishedEndpoints.Sql: SELECT EntityType, EntityId, Title, snippet(MenuSearch, 3, '<mark>', '</mark>', ' ... ', 12) AS Match FROM MenuSearch WHERE MenuSearch MATCH @term ORDER BY rank LIMIT 20;

PublishedEndpoints.Name: Estimate an order
PublishedEndpoints.Sql: SELECT p.PizzaId, p.Name AS PizzaName, s.Name AS Size, @quantity AS Quantity, round((p.BasePricePence + s.PriceAdjustmentPence) / 100.0, 2) AS UnitPrice, round((p.BasePricePence + s.PriceAdjustmentPence) * @quantity / 100.0, 2) AS EstimatedTotal FROM Pizzas p CROSS JOIN PizzaSizes s WHERE p.PizzaId = @pizza_id AND lower(s.Name) = lower(@size) AND @quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20;

PublishedEndpoints.Name: Customer order history
PublishedEndpoints.Sql: SELECT v.OrderId, v.OrderedAtUtc, v.OrderType, v.Status, v.PizzaCount, v.OrderTotal, v.Tip, json_extract(o.PaymentMetadata, '$.source') AS OrderSource FROM Customers c JOIN Orders o ON o.CustomerId = c.CustomerId JOIN vw_OrderSummary v ON v.OrderId = o.OrderId WHERE lower(c.Email) = lower(@email) ORDER BY v.OrderedAtUtc DESC;

PublishedEndpoints.Name: Popular pizza analytics
PublishedEndpoints.Sql: SELECT * FROM vw_PopularPizzas ORDER BY Revenue DESC, PizzaName;

PublishedEndpoints.Name: Delivery-hours menu
PublishedEndpoints.Sql: SELECT PizzaId, PizzaName, Size, Price, EstimatedCalories, AverageRating, 'Delivery available until 22:00 local time' AS Availability FROM vw_CurrentMenu ORDER BY PizzaName, DiameterInches;

PublishedEndpoints.Name: After-hours collection menu
PublishedEndpoints.Sql: SELECT PizzaId, PizzaName, Size, Price, 'Collection only - no delivery after 22:00' AS Availability FROM vw_CurrentMenu WHERE PizzaName = 'Margherita' ORDER BY DiameterInches;

PublishedEndpoints.Name: Frequent customers this month
PublishedEndpoints.Sql: SELECT c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName, c.Email, COUNT(o.OrderId) AS OrdersThisMonth FROM main.Customers c JOIN main.Orders o ON o.CustomerId = c.CustomerId WHERE o.OrderedAtUtc >= datetime('now', 'start of month') GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName, c.Email HAVING COUNT(o.OrderId) > 3 ORDER BY OrdersThisMonth DESC;

PublishedEndpoints.Name: Customers list
PublishedEndpoints.Sql: SELECT CustomerId, FirstName, LastName, Email, LoyaltyPoints, MarketingOptIn FROM Customers ORDER BY CustomerId

PublishedEndpoints.Name: Add a customer
PublishedEndpoints.Sql: INSERT INTO Customers (FirstName, LastName, Email, LoyaltyPoints, MarketingOptIn) VALUES (trim(@first_name), trim(@last_name), trim(@email), @loyalty_points, @marketing_opt_in) RETURNING CustomerId, FirstName, LastName, Email, LoyaltyPoints, MarketingOptIn;

PublishedEndpoints.Name: Update a customer
PublishedEndpoints.Sql: UPDATE Customers SET FirstName = trim(@first_name), LastName = trim(@last_name), Email = trim(@email), LoyaltyPoints = @loyalty_points, MarketingOptIn = @marketing_opt_in WHERE CustomerId = @customer_id RETURNING CustomerId, FirstName, LastName, Email, LoyaltyPoints, MarketingOptIn;

PublishedEndpoints.Name: Delete a customer
PublishedEndpoints.Sql: DELETE FROM Customers WHERE CustomerId = @customer_id RETURNING CustomerId, FirstName, LastName;

PublishedEndpoints.Name: Menu with prices
PublishedEndpoints.Sql: SELECT p.Name AS Pizza, p.Description, round((p.BasePricePence + (SELECT PriceAdjustmentPence FROM PizzaSizes WHERE Name = 'Personal')) / 100.0, 2) AS Personal, round((p.BasePricePence + (SELECT PriceAdjustmentPence FROM PizzaSizes WHERE Name = 'Medium')) / 100.0, 2) AS Medium, round((p.BasePricePence + (SELECT PriceAdjustmentPence FROM PizzaSizes WHERE Name = 'Large')) / 100.0, 2) AS Large, round((p.BasePricePence + (SELECT PriceAdjustmentPence FROM PizzaSizes WHERE Name = 'Family')) / 100.0, 2) AS Family FROM Pizzas p ORDER BY p.Name;

PublishedEndpoints.Name: Place a customer order
Kitchen queue
PublishedEndpoints.Sql:
SELECT o.OrderId,
    c.FirstName || ' ' || c.LastName AS Customer,
    o.OrderType,
    o.Status,
    (SELECT group_concat(i.Quantity || ' x ' || s.Name || ' ' || p.Name, ', ')
     FROM OrderItems i
     JOIN Pizzas p ON p.PizzaId = i.PizzaId
     JOIN PizzaSizes s ON s.PizzaSizeId = i.PizzaSizeId
     WHERE i.OrderId = o.OrderId) AS Items,
    coalesce(o.Notes, '') AS Notes,
    cast((julianday('now') - julianday(o.OrderedAtUtc)) * 1440 AS INTEGER) AS WaitingMinutes,
    CASE o.Status
        WHEN 'Placed' THEN 'Start preparing'
        WHEN 'Preparing' THEN 'Put it in the oven'
        WHEN 'Baking' THEN 'Mark it ready'
        WHEN 'Ready' THEN CASE o.OrderType WHEN 'Delivery' THEN 'Send it out' ELSE 'Mark it collected' END
        WHEN 'OutForDelivery' THEN 'Mark it delivered'
    END AS NextStep
FROM Orders o
JOIN Customers c ON c.CustomerId = o.CustomerId
WHERE o.Status IN ('Placed', 'Preparing', 'Baking', 'Ready', 'OutForDelivery')
ORDER BY o.OrderedAtUtc;

PublishedEndpoints.Name: Advance an order
PublishedEndpoints.Sql:
UPDATE Orders SET Status = CASE
        WHEN Status = 'Placed' THEN 'Preparing'
        WHEN Status = 'Preparing' THEN 'Baking'
        WHEN Status = 'Baking' THEN 'Ready'
        WHEN Status = 'Ready' AND OrderType = 'Delivery' THEN 'OutForDelivery'
        WHEN Status = 'Ready' THEN 'Delivered'
        WHEN Status = 'OutForDelivery' THEN 'Delivered'
        ELSE Status
    END
WHERE OrderId = @order_id AND Status NOT IN ('Delivered', 'Cancelled')
RETURNING OrderId, Status;
